displayName: OCI-WSTG10-007: Data Classification — PII in Logs
description:
Detects PII data (SSN, credit card, email) appearing in application logs in cleartext

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg10_007", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" LIKE '%data%' AND "value" > 0
